title: Fiscal deficit, explained: why the government borrows over ₹4,600 crore a day
short: Fiscal deficit, explained: why the Centre borrows a third
dek: The Centre has used 42% of this year's deficit target in six months. What the fiscal deficit measures, why most new borrowing pays old interest, and why it matters for loan rates.
card: Nearly ₹1 in every ₹3 the Centre spends in 2026-27 is borrowed, and most of it pays interest. The fiscal deficit, explained.
